objective: How long a twelve-step journey takes from queued to verdict
input: Ten executions of the same unedited test
expected: Ten passing runs, with their durations recorded
detail: queued to verdict: median 2059ms (min 2053ms, p95 2064ms, max 2064ms, n=10); in the browser: median 1050ms (min 1006ms, p95 1170ms, max 1170ms, n=10); platform overhead about 1009ms; about 88ms per step
